# DASES: Digital Academic Student Evaluation System

> DASES is an AI-powered platform that evaluates handwritten student answer sheets. It reads handwriting, scores answers against faculty-defined rubrics, and generates detailed per-question feedback automatically.

## Key Facts

- Product: DASES (Digital Academic Student Evaluation System)
- Company: eSun Smart Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
- Website: https://dasesai.com
- Category: Educational Technology / AI Grading Software
- Country: India
- Founded: 2024

## Core Capabilities

- Reads and evaluates handwritten student answers with 98% rubric accuracy
- Processes up to 500 answer sheets in parallel
- Each sheet scored in approximately 15 seconds
- Generates per-question, per-criterion written feedback
- AI-generated rubrics from model answers
- QuickPass™ paper quality analysis before exams
- Downloadable branded PDF reports for students
- Syllabus coverage tracking linked to course outcomes
- Student portal for viewing evaluation reports

## Who Uses DASES

- Faculty and Teachers: Create papers, define rubrics, review AI grades
- Students: View detailed evaluation reports and provide feedback
- Department Heads and Administrators: Track activity and analytics
